record.original_question: Let P_pi(lambda, kappa) denote the symmetric polynomials that appear in the closure relation for osp(1|2) iterated tensor operators, expanded in the binomial basis (c0 + d0^2)^([pi]-m) (d0^2)^m with coefficients x^pi_m(lambda, kappa). Is there a general closed formula, valid for arbitrary pseudo-degree pi, for these expansion coefficients x^pi_m(lambda, kappa) rather than only the low-order cases computed in the paper?

evidence.quote: Actually these polynomials constitute the major trouble inherent in our theoretical approach because of the weak hope of finding a general formula for expansion coefficients x(λ, κ) over the powers of d0, c0 + d0^2.
At least, that could allow ones to anticipate what kind of identities can occur between expansion coefficients x whose analytical expression seems so difficult to obtain.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the orthosymplectic Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$ and its iterated tensor operators. Within their closure relation there arise certain symmetric polynomials $P_\pi(\lambda,\kappa)$ indexed by a pseudo-degree $\pi$ (a nonnegative integer parameter) and depending on two formal variables $\lambda,\kappa$. Introduce auxiliary variables $c_0,d_0$ and consider the binomial basis
$$\bigl\{\,(c_0+d_0^{\,2})^{[\pi]-m}\,(d_0^{\,2})^{m}\,:\,0\le m\le[\pi]\,\bigr\},$$
where $[\pi]$ denotes the integer part associated with the pseudo-degree $\pi$. Each polynomial $P_\pi(\lambda,\kappa)$ admits a unique expansion
$$P_\pi(\lambda,\kappa)\;=\;\sum_{m=0}^{[\pi]} x^{\pi}_{m}(\lambda,\kappa)\,(c_0+d_0^{\,2})^{[\pi]-m}\,(d_0^{\,2})^{m},$$
defining coefficients $x^{\pi}_{m}(\lambda,\kappa)$ which are functions of $\lambda$ and $\kappa$.

Problem: Determine a general closed-form expression for the coefficients $x^{\pi}_{m}(\lambda,\kappa)$ valid for arbitrary pseudo-degree $\pi$ and all $0\le m\le [\pi]$, rather than merely for low-order values of $\pi$.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface any subsequent work providing a general closed-form expression for the expansion coefficients $x^{\pi}_{m}(\lambda,\kappa)$ associated with $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$ iterated tensor operators in the binomial basis described. Related work on $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$ Clebsch–Gordan coefficients and polynomial representations exists, but none directly resolves this specific expansion-coefficient question. The status is therefore inconclusive from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Generating functions for the osp(1|2) Clebsch-Gordan coefficients
status_evidence.snippet: Derives generating functions for Clebsch-Gordan coefficients of osp(1|2) using the twisted coproduct.
status_evidence.claim: Related osp(1|2) coupling-coefficient work exists but does not address the specific x^pi_m(lambda,kappa) expansion.

status_evidence.title: Representations of the Lie Superalgebra osp(1|2n) with Polynomial Bases
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs polynomial bases for osp(1|2n) representations.
status_evidence.claim: General representation-theoretic constructions for osp do not yield the requested closed formula.
